rows.en:
Destroy the giant Vajra ship believed
to be commanding the Vajra.
The Frontier fleet is now in crisis under organized Vajra attacks. Head for the giant Vajra ship believed to be giving the orders and destroy it at once.

Wipe out the Vajra so they can't disrupt
the experiment using Ranka Lee's song.
Top-secret mission: you will now guard an experiment using Ranka Lee's song. Until the experiment begins, wipe out the Vajra so they can't interfere.

Defend the Macross Quarter and wipe out
the Vajra or survive for 5 minutes.
Evolved Vajra have appeared that even reaction weapons can't harm. They'll be hard to destroy: put defending the Macross Quarter and survival first.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Defend the Battle Frontier for 5 minutes
as it prepares a super-long-distance fold.
To end the war with the Vajra, a super-long-distance fold has been decided on. Defend the Battle Frontier until the super-long-distance fold begins.

Wipe out the Vajra rampaging
inside the Frontier.
A Vajra nest was apparently built inside Macross Frontier, and swarms of Vajra are rampaging inside. Wipe out the Vajra that have emerged in the Frontier.

Stop the deserters who stole the Macross
Quarter from escaping.
Some S.M.S. members have hijacked the Macross Quarter to flee. If they fold out, they'll get away. Stop the deserters from escaping.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
To test the VF-171EX, hold a mock battle
with the Sagittarius Squadron.
rows.notes: Sagittarius Squadron (glossary provisional).

rows.en: A mock battle will now be held to test the VF-171EX, built to fight the Vajra. Defeat the Sagittarius Squadron in this combined machine test and training.
rows.notes: Sagittarius Squadron (glossary provisional).

rows.en:
To make the Vajra homeworld ours,
wipe out the Vajra.
At last we've found the Vajra homeworld; our only hope is to make it our new home. With the Galactic Fairy's song, wipe out the Vajra.
rows.notes: TM 'Wipe out the Vajra, powered by the Galactic Fairy's song' read as if the Vajra were powered by the song; the Japanese means 'using the Galactic Fairy's singing voice as our strength'. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
For the peace of the galaxy,
defeat Grace O'Connor.
Grace O'Connor's group, who'd use even the Vajra to seize the galaxy, were the true masterminds. For the peace of the galaxy, defeat Grace O'Connor.

Wipe out the unknown lifeforms
that have invaded Island 1.
Capt. Gilliam has gone ahead in pursuit of the unknown enemy that invaded the Frontier. Back him up at once and annihilate the unknown enemy.
rows.notes: Giriamu taii in a Frontier mission (MK_020, invasion of Island 1) = Henry Gilliam, S.M.S. captain (glossary, male).

rows.en:
As part of training, fight the Vajra
in a simulator battle.
Simulator training for Vajra attacks begins. The data recreates Vajra combat exactly, so treat this drill as real and wipe out the Vajra.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Beat the expert gamers at the smash-hit
game "Battroid Attack F".

Head-to-Head Valkyrie Simulation  ~BATTROID ATTACK!! F~
                                  PLEASE INSERT COIN(S)
rows.notes: Arcade attract-screen layout kept as MUF shipped the original Battroid Attack line (u2891).

rows.en:
Ozma: "As of now, we at S.M.S. launch the rescue operation for the Galaxy
      fleet's refugee ships! Mission code......"
rows.notes: Speaker-label briefing in MUF's speaker layout (label, quote, indented second line).

rows.en:
Wipe out the Vajra that
appeared in the Frontier fleet.
The Vajra have followed the Galaxy refugee ship we rescued and appeared at the Frontier. Wipe them out at once so they get no closer to the Frontier.

Wipe out the Vajra while
guarding the concert venue.
The Vajra have broken into the Frontier and are attacking a concert venue full of civilians. Protect the venue and wipe out the Vajra at once.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en: Wipe out the rogue Zentradi forces.
Unidentified units, likely rogue Zentradi, are near Jupiter. Break their will to fight with Operation Minmay, then annihilate them.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Wipe out the mysterious mecha
rampaging through the city.
Mecha from a mysterious fleet slipped through our defenses and invaded Earth. Wipe out the mobile weapons ravaging the city as if seeking something. Now!

Escort Lt. Silvie to the target area
and annihilate the Mardook forces.
At the Moon Festival, the Mardook forces abducted Lt. Silvie. Escort Lt. Silvie as she escapes, then annihilate the Mardook forces.
rows.notes: Moon Festival (Macross II event) is not in the glossary. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en: We've rescued the civilians held captive on a Mardook battleship, but we haven't escaped the enemy ship yet. Get out of it at all costs.

Wipe out the Mardook forces seeking
to destroy Earth's culture.
The Mardook forces have launched an all-out assault to destroy Earth's culture. Protect Earth's culture at all costs and wipe out the Mardook forces.
The Mardook advance won't stop, and the U.N. Forces are now in dire straits. To break out of this, the Macross will fire its main gun. Escort the Macross.

As part of the event, fight a
mock battle against Capt. Nexx.
rows.notes: Nekkusu taii = Nexx Gilbert (glossary needs_check); the Japanese uses the short name.

rows.en: As part of the Moon Festival events, a mock battle now begins. Win the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace pilot Capt. Nexx.

As part of training, fight a mock
battle against the Faerie Squadron.
rows.notes: Fearii Riidaa-tai = Faerie Squadron (glossary provisional).

rows.en: To prepare for battle with the rogue Zentradi, a mock battle now begins. Win the mock battle against the Faerie Squadron, led by Lt. Silvie Gena.
rows.notes: Faerie Squadron (glossary provisional).

rows.en:
As part of conversion training,
fight a mock battle on the ground.
As part of conversion training, a mock battle on the ground now begins. It may be training, but stay sharp: wipe out the enemy and win the mock battle.

As part of conversion training,
fight a mock battle in the air.
As part of conversion training, a mock battle in the air now begins. It may be training, but stay sharp: wipe out the enemy and win the mock battle.

As part of conversion training,
fight a mock battle at sea.
As part of conversion training, a mock battle at sea now begins. It may be training, but stay sharp: wipe out the enemy and win the mock battle.

As part of conversion training,
fight a mock battle in space.
As part of conversion training, a mock battle in space now begins. It may be training, but stay sharp: wipe out the enemy and win the mock battle.

Believe in the power of culture
and destroy Boddole Zer's fleet.
rows.notes: Boddole Zer kantai: Boddole Zer's fleet (not the glossary's 'Boddole Zer Main Fleet', which is a different Japanese term).

rows.en: A huge Zentradi horde has appeared and is about to invade Earth again. Annihilate the Zentradi forces at all costs to protect Earth from this crisis.

Support Basara in his song
battle with an unknown unit.
A Song Energy experiment detected abnormal Song Energy from a remote planet. Investigate it with Basara, who has already rushed ahead.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Wipe out the Vajra
to defend Macross City.
Vajra controlled by Grace have suddenly appeared in Macross City on Earth. We can't let Macross City come to harm. Wipe out the Vajra at once.

To retake the communications relay base,
wipe out Vindirance.
We move to retake the relay base seized by the anti-U.N. group Vindirance. Enter via the canyon and wipe out the Vindirance guards.
rows.notes: 'communications' dropped from 'relay base' to fit two lines (the objective row u3062 names it in full). Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Wipe out Vindirance, who are scheming
to fold to Earth.
Vindirance is plotting a fold to Earth. It must be stopped at all costs, so reaction weapons are authorized for this operation. Wipe out Vindirance.

To shatter Latence's ambitions,
destroy the Macross.
We'll now descend to Earth and infiltrate Macross City. To shatter Latence's ambitions, destroy the jamming system mounted in the Macross's head.
Shake off the oncoming Nightmares!
rows.notes: Akumu = Nightmare, the VF-17's nickname (cf. u0314 'Nightmare Assault Operation').

rows.en: The VF-17 series: variable fighters nicknamed "Nightmare." Wipe out the VF-17 series to shake off the swarm of Nightmares bearing down on you.

Win the battle against the units
with "Red" as their main color.
"Red": the color said to stand for passion... Win the battle against these hot-blooded guys, who let that very feeling blaze wildly.

Win the battle against the units
with "Blue" as their main color.
"Blue": the color said to stand for calm... Win the battle against these cool guys, who are never swayed by that kind of feeling.

Destroy every generation of Queadluun
as you head for the target area.
While you toured a base storing every generation of Queadluun, the Queadluuns somehow went on a rampage. Destroy them as you escape to the target area.

Win the battle against every
generation of Destroid.
Overshadowed by variable fighters, the Destroids rarely got to shine. Now they have revolted to show what they can do. Put them down.
rows.notes: Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the mock battle against the special
forces unit Moon Island Platoon.
A mock battle now begins vs. the special forces unit codenamed "Moon Island". They're all problem children, but reportedly skilled. Defeat Moon Island.
Annihilate the large battleships.
An observation ship reports a horde of large battleships advancing on Earth. We can't let them get any closer to Earth. Annihilate them at once.
Surpass the Super Dimension Fortress!
rows.notes: Choujikuu yousai = Super Dimension Fortress, as in the glossary work title. 240 px against a ~175 px estimate; the name cannot be shortened, and shipped objective lines reach 274 px.

rows.en: The Macross ended the interstellar war, and colony ships across the galaxy took its name. Beat them and surpass the Super Dimension Fortress!
rows.notes: Imin-sen = colony (emigrant) ships, the Macross-named fleets. Refit: briefing lines hold 79 characters, 2 lines (MUF finding).

rows.en:
Win the dogfight against variable
fighters of every generation.

uncertain: Mission objective rows: TM lines over the per-line estimate kept as MUF shipped them (widest shipped objective line in the corpus: 274 px); new objective lines kept at or under ~274 px.

u3044, u3045: Capt. Nexx = Nexx Gilbert, glossary status needs_check.
u3046, u3047: Faerie Squadron (Fairy Leader-tai) is provisional in the glossary.
u3029: Ozma's speaker-label briefing written in MUF's speaker layout rather than one paragraph.
u3071, u3073: 'yatsura' rendered 'guys' (opponent units, no specific people).
u3083: rendered 'Beat the ships that bear the Macross name' for the Japanese 'win the battle against the ships bearing the Macross name'.
